<DESCRIPTION>EXTENSION AGREEMENT WITH ROSENBERG, FEBRUARY 3, 2010
<TEXT>

<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>

<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.17</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>EXTENSION AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt; text-align: left">Dated this 3rd day of February 2010 and effective June 30, 2008
(the &quot;Effective Date&quot;) by and between Viral Genetics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &quot;Company&quot;), and Dr.
Eric S. Rosenberg (&quot;Consultant&quot;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left"><B>WHEREAS</B> Company and Consultant are
party to a Consulting Agreement dated July 1, 2006 (the &quot;Original Agreement&quot;) and wish to extend it subject to certain
terms and conditions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left"><B>NOW, THEREFORE</B>, for good and lawful
consideration and of the mutual covenants contained herein and the mutual benefits to be derived hereunder, the parties agree
as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 17pt; text-align: right">1.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">The Parties represent and warrant that the Term of the Original Agreement was verbally
extended on the Effective Date and that this Extension Agreement represents a formal documentation of same.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 17pt; text-align: right">2.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">The Term of the Original Agreement is hereby extended indefinitely until such time
as it is terminated in accordance with Section 13 of the Original Agreement.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 17pt; text-align: right">3.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left">All other terms and conditions of the Original Agreement shall continue in full force
and effect, including without limitation, those in Exhibit D therein entitled &quot;Viral Genetics Intellectual Property Agreement&quot;,
from June 30, 2008 through the date hereof.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
